messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Baker Hughes
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Simonelli,

Following my earlier introduction, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Baker Hughes' current growth agenda across LNG, power generation, data-center infrastructure, international energy security and lower-carbon technology.

The paper sets out practical areas where my operating experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulatory coordination, local-value delivery and executive stakeholder management would support complex international growth and project execution. My executive CV is included in the final three pages.

I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding international leadership needs across government relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships, sustainability, country strategy or related stakeholder-facing functions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Baker Hughes
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Baker Hughes is expanding across a wider energy and industrial opportunity set that now connects LNG, upstream technology, power generation, data-center infrastructure, carbon management and energy security. Second-quarter 2026 performance showed strong order momentum and a large Industrial & Energy Technology backlog, while recent awards in the United States, Asia and emerging markets broaden the institutional and stakeholder interfaces surrounding delivery. My director-level experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulatory coordination and local-value execution would support Baker Hughes by strengthening country alignment, stakeholder governance and the conversion of external commitments into measurable operational outcomes.
strategic_brief.company_context: Baker Hughes reported second-quarter 2026 orders of $10.5 billion and remaining performance obligations of $40.1 billion, including a record $37.1 billion within Industrial & Energy Technology. Recent growth spans major LNG equipment, gas infrastructure, subsea systems, data-center power and mature-field optimization. The September 2026 Venture Global awards reinforce the company's role across integrated gas infrastructure, while power-generation orders for data centers extend Baker Hughes into fast-growing electricity demand. These projects sit within national energy-security, industrial-policy, permitting, workforce, local-content and sustainability agendas. Strong external-affairs execution is therefore increasingly tied to commercial momentum, schedule assurance, reputation and long-term client confidence across multiple jurisdictions.

opportunities.title: Country and institutional alignment
opportunities.rationale: Large LNG, subsea, power and industrial projects depend on governments, regulators, national energy companies and local institutions whose policy priorities and approval processes differ materially across markets. Earlier alignment improves decision visibility and reduces external friction during execution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build country stakeholder maps, issue registers and executive escalation routes that connect government engagement, permitting, client priorities and internal project ownership to clear decisions, deadlines and evidence.

opportunities.title: Local value and strategic partnerships
opportunities.rationale: Energy investments increasingly carry expectations for local workforce development, supplier participation, technology transfer and wider economic contribution. These commitments influence competitiveness, public confidence and long-term relationships with state-linked customers and host governments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would translate local-value expectations into measurable plans across procurement, workforce, community and partnership functions, with named owners and executive reporting that links external commitments directly to operating delivery.

opportunities.title: Data-center power stakeholder strategy
opportunities.rationale: Rapid growth in data-center power creates new interfaces across utilities, regulators, communities, grid planning, emissions expectations and industrial customers. Baker Hughes' expanding turbine platform benefits from a coordinated external strategy around reliability, speed, environmental performance and infrastructure acceptance.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would structure a stakeholder framework around priority data-center power markets, connecting regulatory pathways, community considerations, energy-security narratives and sustainability evidence with commercial and technical teams.

opportunities.title: Sustainability evidence and executive assurance
opportunities.rationale: Baker Hughes is advancing emissions reduction while serving conventional and lower-carbon energy markets. External claims require credible operating evidence and consistent governance so customers, governments and investors understand how technology, operational performance and sustainability objectives connect.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen traceability between ESG commitments, operating data and executive communications, drawing on experience with carbon-data assurance, environmental management systems and cross-functional evidence ownership in a regulated resource business.

days_0_30: Map priority markets, institutions, clients and regulatory dependencies.
Review material stakeholder, local-value and sustainability commitments.
Identify external issues with direct schedule, commercial or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align government, commercial, project and sustainability engagement plans.
Create a single issue and commitment register with named owners and deadlines.
Define executive indicators for country alignment, local-value delivery and stakeholder risk.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on the highest-value institutional and regulatory dependencies.
Embed monthly cross-functional review of commitments and country risks.
Strengthen evidence controls for public sustainability and local-value claims.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority international markets.
Measure issue closure, stakeholder response times and commitment performance.
Codify lessons into a repeatable country and strategic-partnership playbook.

potential_impact: Faster resolution of government and regulatory issues affecting major projects.
Stronger local-value delivery and public-sector confidence across international markets.
Improved alignment between energy-security positioning, sustainability evidence and commercial execution.
Better executive visibility across external risks tied to growth projects.
background_relevance: Director-level leadership across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational resource business.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities and contractors on permits, commitments and strategic projects.
Cross-functional execution across operations, legal, finance, procurement, environment, HR and executive leadership.
Practical experience with renewable-energy positioning, carbon-data traceability, environmental systems and local participation.
